questions: p1 gradient_check acceptance (< 1e-6) fails at the final weights: the relative-error metric divides by |numeric|+|analytic| and the gradient at the GD optimum is about 1e-6, so central-difference round-off (about 1e-10 absolute) shows as 6e-3 relative. At zeros the error is 4.6e-7 and at random weights about 1e-8. The check itself is fine; the SPEC acceptance point is mis-posed. Suggest the chief accept a check at zeros plus a random point, or an absolute-error floor in gd.gradient_check (shared lib, not mine). I did not change anything.
